name: Garage bump 505 kit
desc: Bumpy garage-house kit on the neglected TR-505: solid four with a doubled-kick bump into beat 3, heavily swung claps that flam against a rim, and hats whose accent rotates one 16th every cycle. NYC garage bounce (Kerri/ MAW) rather than the catalog's clean 909 four or dusty 707 — the bump and the flam are the signature.

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR505").shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("~ [~ ~ ~ bd] ~ ~").bank("RolandTR505").speed(1.05).gain(${gain}*.45), s("~ ~ [cp rim] ~").bank("RolandTR505").gain(.42).late(${swing}).room(.25), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR505").gain(".34 .14 .22 .16 .3 .14 .24 .18").iter(8).late(${swing}), s("lt(1,8,6)").bank("RolandTR505").gain(.3)).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR505").shape(.4).gain(${gain}), s("[~ ~ bd ~](3,8)").bank("RolandTR505").speed(1.1).gain(${gain}*.4), s("~ ~ [cp rim] ~").bank("RolandTR505").gain(.5).late(${swing}).room(.3), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR505").gain(".32 .12 .2 .14").iter(16).late(${swing}), s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR505").gain(.3), s("lt(2,8,<3 6>)").bank("RolandTR505").gain(.34)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
